She tells me that it's different and I can't figure out how so I point out how I've finished food she couldn't before and she's no stranger to my germs. I know that whatever viruses or bacteria I may have was spread to her when I kissed her seconds before I got the pizza out of the oven. She wasn't having it and apparently I ruined her appetite so now she's locked herself in the bedroom, still hungry and now refusing to talk to me. Did I take it too far by bringing it up? I mean I felt like she called me disgusting and wanted clarification.
